current_test_status: historical agent observations within their own scope

rules: Record conflicting scope and dates; do not silently select the convenient source.
A manifest does not invalidate reproducible contrary behaviour.
Proposed policy does not mean proposed software.
A test against FREE never qualifies PRO.
Network failure is UNAVAILABLE, not absence.
An agent not running a test does not establish that the product was never tested. A publisher confirmation does not invent agent execution, binary identity or independent audit.
